chunks: We made them leaders calling to Hell; and on the Day of Judgement they will not be helped.
ai.seo_question: Who are the leaders that call to Hell according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as describing both specific historical figures and a general category of leaders who guide their followers toward misguidance, contrasting with the 'Imams of Guidance' mentioned in verse 28:5. The phrase 'they will not be helped' underscores the finality of their defeat, emphasizing that their authority was derived from God but lost due to their deviation. This serves as a cautionary principle for the Ummah regarding the nature of true versus false leadership.
